Name: StarAmys Seasonal Valley 1.6
Author: StarAmy
Description:
[i][size=4]Two sets down, six to go! [/size]

[size=4]For everyone wondering, you can probably expect mods to drop about once a month until they're done.[/size][/i][i]

[size=4]~Amy[/size]

[size=4]Please note:[/size]

[b][size=5]New content patcher furniture may not be compatible with DGA -> CP conversion mod (I took the opportunity to do some name cleanup/simplification in areas) [/size][/b]

[size=4]and   [/size]

[/i][b][size=5]Elegant Seasonal Farm Buildings returns the Slime Hutch to it's original pre-1.6 size [/size]
[/b]

[b][size=4]Elegant Seasonal Farm Buildings[/size][/b]
[size=3]Replaces all farm buildings (except the ones from the wizard, for now) with a slightly funky victorian-esque set. Requires Content Patcher.
[/size][b][size=3]Features:[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=3]Support for vanilla colors or DaisyNiko's Earthy recolor (more coming)[/size]
[*][size=3]Miscellaneous seasonal and holiday decor for the farmhouse[/size]
[*][size=3]Turn your Slime Hutch into a winery with seasonal grape vines to match various other brewing-themed mods[/size]
[*][size=3]24 different window decoration themes you can apply to the identical Shed and Big Shed for custom mix and matching (see Shed Skin Insanity below for a list, and if you want to be able to apply different themes to each shed building, since this will change all of the same). Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11732]catmao's Flower Shop Shed [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12174]Sizuo's Coffee Shop[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=3]In case you prefer to use cabins as sheds, or just add some flair to your living space, apply the same variety of windows to them.[/size]
[*][size=3]Configurable extras for the stable so your horse is nice and comfy.[/size]
[*][size=3]Turns the pre-upgrade greenhouse into a cute little pond with a bench and hammock.[/size]
[/list][size=3][b]Config Options[/b]
[list]
[*][b]﻿"Recolor":[/b] "Vanilla, Earthy",
[*] [b]"Color Scheme"[/b]: "Forest, Cream, Slate",
[*] [b]"[Shed, Big Shed, Stone Cabin, Plank Cabin, Log Cabin] Theme":[/b] "None, Apothecary, Books, Boutique, Brewery, Bait, Butcher, Cafe, Candy, ﻿Christmas, Exotic, Farm, Fish, Florist, ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Gallery, ﻿Grocery, Hardware, Jewelry, Museum, Occult, Pets Plant, Spooky, Tea, Wine"
[*][b] "Fish Pond Rocks"[/b]: "Grey, Tan, Red, White",
[*] [b]"Shipping Bin":[/b] "Empty, Fruit, Flowers, Mushrooms, Seafood",
[*] "[b]Bedding": [/b]"true, false",
[*] [b]"Troughs":[/b] "true, false",
[*][b] "Salt Lick":[/b] "true, false",
[*][b] "Crate of Apples": [/b]"true, false",
[/list] [/size]

[b][size=4]Elegant Seasonal Shed Skin Variety
[/size][/b][size=3]24 Shed front window themes, in 3 color schemes, with all seasonal variations, so you can have infinite shed front variety. Give your workshops a front to match or just make decorative rows of 'shops'! Requires Alternative Textures.[/size]
[size=3][b]Colors:[/b] Cream, Slate, Forest
[b]Themes:[/b] Apothecary, Books, Boutique, Brewery, Bait, Butcher, Cafe, Candy, Christmas, Exotic, Farm, Fish, Florist, Gallery, Grocery, Hardware, Jewelry, Museum, Occult, Pets Plant, Spooky, Tea, Wine[/size]


[size=4][b]Easter Bunnies[/b]
[/size][size=3]Some cute little bunnies wearing colored ribbons will now appear and hop around the mountains and forest during spring. Requires Custom Companions and Content Patcher. [/size]


[b][size=4]Halloween Costumes[/size][/b][size=4]
[/size][size=3]A clothing set featuring just a few new spirit's eve costume options but with more planned. Requires Fashion Sense.[/size]


[b][size=4]Seasonal and Holiday Furniture[/size][size=5]***NEW(ish)[/size][/b][size=4] -[b] [/b][/size][size=4]Includes content from all of my holiday and seasonal furniture packs.[/size]
[size=3]Dozens of festive decorations and furniture pieces to celebrate the passing of the seasons. Requires Content Patcher.
[/size]
[b][size=4]Glass Gem Corn[/size][size=5]***NEW[/size][/b][size=4]
[/size][size=3]A colorful new fall crop, new machine recipes, and a craftable decorative cornucopia! Process corn into oil in the oil maker or dried corn in the dehydrator. Requires Content Patcher.[/size]

[*][size=3]My witchy shoes aren't layering correctly under the skirts/pants correctly, so that will be fixed as soon as I figure out what needs to change. For now, just skip using them.[/size]

[/size][size=3]Please report any you encounter! Be sure to include your SMAPI log via [url=https://smapi.io/log]https://smapi.io/log[/url] when possible.
[/size]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/XvsLXvi.png[/img]

[b]My building/furniture/object reskins don’t show up in game even though I have the right mods installed.[/b]
[size=3]There’s a pretty good chance something else is patching the same sprites and winning the fight. You can use Content Patcher’s terminal commands to quickly find the cause of the problem in most cases, and then disable the conflicting mod or specific patch. [/size]

[b]Where do I find the new clothing items? They don't appear at shops.
[/b][size=3]Correct! You'll need fashion sense's hand mirror to access them instead. Check it out for sale at Pierre's.[/size]

[b]How do I change through Alternative Texture skins for an object or building? 
[/b][size=3]You'll want the Paint Bucket, bought from Robin at the Carpenter's.[/size]
